title: Flood forecast discussion
description: A hydrologic forecast discussion: how the river forecast was made and what changed since the last issuance, in plain prose sections (rainfall, current river conditions, forecast reasoning, uncertainty, next issuance). Written by a service hydrologist or river forecast center. Shows the previous and current forecast crest so a change of category is plain. Stage in feet with the gauge datum; times local with zone.

office.description: Issuing office or River Forecast Center.
examples: National Weather Service River Forecast Center, Fort Worth
Cedar River forecast discussion for Riverbend (RBDM7)

change.description: The crest before and after this issuance.

sections.description: Discussion sections with a heading and prose.

examples: Radar-estimated rainfall of 3.1 to 4.6 inches fell over the upper basin since Friday morning, more than the 2 to 3 inches forecast.

nextIssuance.description: When the next forecast is expected.
examples: The next forecast will be issued by 1000 PM CST tonight.
